source.title: Call for Applicants - WCT Graphics Members (October 2019)
source.content:
The WCT is seeking new members to help with graphics design for social media posts and other projects!

The application is open to all WCA members. You do not have to hold a current position to be considered. This position is directed to those with graphic design experience and duties once on the team will mainly focus on that type of work.
<!-- break -->
**What does the WCT do?**
- Answers daily inquires to the WCA through emails and the contact page on the WCA website.
- Manages official WCA social media platforms through frequent & engaging posts
- Works with other WCA leaders to improve the WCA website and communications to the community

The rights and duties of WCT from our By-laws can be found [here](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1WoMypP_o06DXhJ8jvZ2pcsWgN_bG0zyjSnsBlyY8ls8/edit?usp=sharing).

**Workflow Outline**
- Social media posts are planned at least 1 week in advance and are posted when members are available.
- Internal emails regarding other WCT projects are answered within 48 hours and other work may come from those projects that take various amounts of time.
- Time commitment per week is between 4-10 hours.
- Must be familiar with Adobe Illustrator, GIMP, or equivalent programs

**Characteristics we are looking for**
- Creativity: *We always need ideas of new social media series or unique ways to expand to other platforms. You will be required to think about this and suggest ideas when you can. With your graphic design experience, you will help us with designing visually compelling posts.*
- Social media knowledge: *You should be familiar with many social media platforms and their basic functions. While you may not have used them personally, you will have to post to them as the WCA and should know what type of content goes on each.*
- Fluent English: *Our posts on most social media platforms are in English and we answer most emails in English. We do welcome those that are fluent in other languages alongside English.*
- Communication skills: *You will be responsible for designing social media posts that are appropriate and convey the mission of the WCA.*
- Patience: *You should keep friendly communications within our email and social media interactions.*

**To apply, please include:**
- A brief personal introduction
- Your involvement with the WCA
- Your motivation for applying to the WCT
- Your familiarity with social media platforms & an idea of a potential WCA post
- 2-3 designs that you have created to highlight your design style

Please send the application in **PDF format** to [lclement@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:lclement@worldcubeassociation.org) from now until **December 10, 2019, 23:59 UTC** to be considered.

There may be an additional interview requested of candidates with the leader following application submission. The week after the application period, the team will make a selection and the new member(s) will be announced once candidates have accepted the positions. If you have any questions regarding the application process, do not hesitate to reach out to Lauren Clement ([lclement@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:lclement@worldcubeassociation.org)).

Thank you for your candidacies and support!

translation.title: 招募 WCA 通讯组平面设计成员（2019 年 10 月）
translation.content:
WCA 通讯组（WCT）正在招募新成员，协助设计社交媒体帖子及其他项目的图片！

所有 WCA 会员都可以申请，不要求申请者目前已在 WCA 任职。这一职位面向有平面设计经验的人，加入团队后的职责也将以此类工作为主。

**WCT 负责什么？**

- 通过邮件及 WCA 网站联系页面，回复日常咨询。
- 管理 WCA 官方社交媒体平台，定期发布有吸引力的内容。
- 与 WCA 其他负责人合作，改善网站及面向社区的沟通。

章程中 WCT 的权利与职责可在[这里](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1WoMypP_o06DXhJ8jvZ2pcsWgN_bG0zyjSnsBlyY8ls8/edit?usp=sharing)查看。

**工作流程概况**

- 社交媒体帖子至少提前 1 周规划，在成员有空时发布。
- 涉及 WCT 其他项目的内部邮件须在 48 小时内回复；这些项目也可能带来其他工作，所需时间各不相同。
- 每周需投入 4–10 小时。
- 必须熟悉 Adobe Illustrator、GIMP 或同类软件。

**我们希望申请者具备的素质**

- 创意：*我们一直需要新的社交媒体系列内容构思，以及拓展其他平台的独特方式。你需要思考这些问题，并在有想法时提出建议。你的平面设计经验将帮助我们制作视觉上有吸引力的帖子。*
- 社交媒体知识：*你应熟悉多个社交媒体平台及其基本功能。即使自己没有使用过，也需要代表 WCA 在这些平台发帖，并了解各平台适合什么内容。*
- 流利的英语：*我们在大多数社交媒体平台上使用英语发帖，也用英语回复大多数邮件。同时欢迎除英语外还熟练掌握其他语言的人加入。*
- 沟通能力：*你将负责设计内容得体、能够传达 WCA 使命的社交媒体帖子。*
- 耐心：*在邮件和社交媒体交流中保持友好。*

**申请材料请包含：**

- 简短的个人介绍。
- 参与 WCA 的经历。
- 申请加入 WCT 的原因。
- 对社交媒体平台的熟悉程度，以及一条可供 WCA 发布的帖子构思。
- 2–3 件自己创作的设计作品，展示个人设计风格。

请于即日起至 **2019 年 12 月 10 日 23:59 UTC**，将 **PDF 格式**的申请发送至 [lclement@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:lclement@worldcubeassociation.org)。

提交申请后，候选人可能还需与负责人面试。申请期结束后的下一周，团队将选出人选，并在候选人接受职位后公布新成员名单。如对申请流程有疑问，请联系 Lauren Clement（[lclement@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:lclement@worldcubeassociation.org)）。

感谢大家的申请与支持！
